entities.summary: The Church of Saints Peter and Paul or the Petropavlovsk Church is a Russian Orthodox church in Starocherkasskaya stanitsa, Aksaysky District, Rostov Oblast, Russia that was built in 1751. It is one of the oldest churches in all of Rostov Oblast.
